description:
About the role
Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.
Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.
We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.
Your role
You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.
What you will do
Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

description:
About Andercore
Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.
Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.
We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.
We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.
Where we are today:
Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

Seven European markets…

description:
About Act
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 
Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role
You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing.
This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows.
There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up.

What You'll Be Doing
Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks.

Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting,…

description:
About Prelude
Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.
Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.
Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. 
But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.
Why join us
Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.
We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values 
Care
We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

description:
About us:
DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.
Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.
Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

【岗位职责】

1、全面负责专业交易平台的产品规划、路线图设计、版本迭代和落地质量。

2、深入研究专业交易员、资深交易用户及机构/半机构用户的交易流程，抽象核心需求并转化为产品方案。
3、负责专业 K 线、行情展示、下单面板、订单管理、持仓管理、选择交易、多腿交易等核心模块设计。
4、对标主流专业版及传统金融交易终端，持续提升产品专业度和易用性。
5、与研发、设计、交易系统、风控、运营等团队协作，推动复杂交易场景高质量交付。
6、建立并跟踪产品指标，关注专业用户留存、交易转化、使用深度、交易效率和用户满意度。
6、对交易链路的效率、安全感、稳定性、信息密度和专业用户体验负责，持续打磨产品细节。

【任职要求】

1、5 年以上产品经验，有专业交易终端、行情软件、券商、期货、外汇、衍生品、金融交易平台等相关产品经验。
2、具备较深交易理解，熟悉专业交易用户的实际工作流，包括看盘、分析、下单、盯仓、止盈止损、订单管理等场景。
3、熟悉 K 线、盘口、订单簿、限价单、市价单、条件单、止盈止损、持仓、成交、资金等基础交易能力。
4、有复杂 Web 工具型产品经验，能处理高信息密度、高交互频率、高稳定性要求的产品场景。

5、具备较强产品判断力，能够识别专业用户真实痛点，而不是简单复制竞品功能。

6、具备产品负责人意识，能独立制定方向、拆解路径、推动跨团队协作，并对最终产品结果负责。

7、具备优秀的 PRD、交互方案、需求优先级判断、AI使用能力和项目推进能力。

【加分项】

1、做过聚合交易、跨所交易、多腿交易、策略交易、专业 K 线、行情系统或量化辅助工具。

2、自己有股票、期货、外汇、期权或其他衍生品交易经验，深度使用各类交易终端产品

3、有国际化交易产品经验，理解不同市场交易用户的使用习惯。

4、对交易系统、撮合、风控、行情延迟、订单状态流转等底层机制有一定理解。

【为什么是这个岗位】
交易平台不能只靠交易工具赢得用户注意力。下一层增长来自内容、关系、社区信任，以及用户在股票、港美股、虚拟货币和 Web3 场景中的社交决策。你将主导社交产品线从早期规模走向成熟体系，把社区行为转化为拉新、日活、留存、内容消费时长和交易转化。未来 12-24 个月，你要留下一个有差异化的社交产品矩阵、一套更清晰的增长引擎，以及一支能够持续迭代的产品团队。
【你要做什么】

制定社交产品战略、定位、阶段目标和产品矩阵，覆盖主流资产交易用户与 Web3 场景

建立社交渗透率、日活、留存率、内容消费时长、创作者活跃和交易转化等指标体系，并用数据决定优先级

从用户研究、竞品判断和行为数据中识别真实需求，转化为提升活跃、粘性和信任的产品决策

搭建产品团队的目标、节奏和跨部门协作机制，连接增长、运营、内容、KOL、合规、安全和研发

在产品设计阶段纳入内容安全、隐私保护、数据安全和行业合规要求，避免规模化之后补漏洞

【你需要带来什么】
Non-negotiables

你完整主导过社交、社区、内容分发或增长产品，从策略制定到上线迭代，并拿到可衡量结果

你理解交易用户如何建立判断、追踪信号、消费内容、与他人互动，并把信任转化为行动

你能在用户反馈、市场变化、竞品动作、数据模式和业务目标之间提炼清晰产品方向

你带过小型产品团队，能建立协作规则，并把内容安全、隐私保护、数据安全和合规要求放进产品决策

Bonus

你做过金融科技社区、券商 App、交易平台、虚拟货币交易所、Web3 生态或社交交易产品

你熟悉内容推流、创作者生态、社区机制、群组互动、直播内容或内容驱动增长

【招聘经理寄语】
我们寻找的不是一个只会做社区功能的人，而是一个真正理解内容、关系与交易如何相互驱动的产品领导者。这个岗位需要你既能看见长期趋势，也能把复杂问题拆成可落地的产品路径。我们希望你能和团队一起，打造一个不只是让用户交易，更让用户愿意停留、互动、分享和建立信任的平台。

About Lokal
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. 
This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. 
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved. 
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

Hi, I’m Andy, the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.

I worked across Creative and Logistics, built our tech pack template, mapped development timelines, and brought in technical support. description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?

Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

Relocation package.

Flexible working hours.

English-speaking environment.

We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems

description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection…

Functie  Reliability engineer

Beschrijving functie

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 

Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

Join our Product team to shape the future of financial access and infrastructure. We're not just improving global payments—we're reinventing them. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

You will be a key member of our growing Threat Detection & Response (TDR) team.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

UX Writing is a core design discipline at Airbnb. Our team of 40+ writers works closely with Experience Design, Experience Research, Engineering, and Design Program Management to support the product development process from beginning to end. Whether you excel in upfront storytelling, end-to-end systems design, or nitty-gritty execution, you'll find your people here.

The Difference You Will Make:

From concept to launch, our UX writers create industry-leading experiences for guests and hosts that meaningfully impact the success of the company. In this role, you'll shape how AI-powered, generative surfaces speak to hosts and you'll build the systems that keep that voice consistent as models change. You'll help set the standard for how our team partners with Engineering to define the ideal experience, evaluate generated output, and iterate to improve the product, and you'll bring the rest of UX Writing along with you.

summary: About Us  At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties…
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
